name: Hong Kong
why: Victoria Peak, the harbor and Dragon's Back give it a stronger setting than Prague and Edinburgh, which it ties at 6.9. Level with Istanbul.

name: Barcelona
why: Mountains, sea and Gaudí together; at 5.4 it sits below Rome, Vienna and Lisbon. Level with New York and Seoul.

name: Chicago
why: Owner picked 4.7 (suggested 4.9). The lakefront skyline is among the best city views in the US; at 3.8 it is below Berlin and Copenhagen.

name: Cuba
why: Viñales, Trinidad, the cays and the Sierra Maestra; at 7.3 it sits below Jamaica, Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic.

name: Barbados
why: A small flat island of beaches; at 7.9 it sits above Jamaica, Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic and Cuba, which have mountains and more variety.

name: Palau
why: The Rock Islands are among the best seascapes anywhere; at 8.9 it is below Fiji, whose signature view is weaker.

name: Turks & Caicos
why: Flat islands around one kind of view; at 9.0 it ties Sardinia and sits above Bali and the Galápagos.

name: Hokkaido
why: Large and varied: volcanoes, caldera lakes, lavender fields and drift ice; at 8.2 it is below the Canary Islands and the Falkland Islands.

name: Yellowstone National Park
why: Grand Prismatic Spring, the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone and Hayden Valley in one park; at 9.4 it is below Arches, Death Valley and Uluru. Level with Glacier & Waterton Lakes, which it should not beat.

name: Southeast Alaska & the Inside Passage
why: Glaciers, fjords and rainforest on a huge scale; at 9.4 it is level with Amalfi and the Great Barrier Reef. Level with Monterey & Big Sur.

name: Tasmania
why: Cradle Mountain, the Bay of Fires and Wineglass Bay; at 8.5 it is below Nova Scotia.

name: Okavango Delta
why: Owner picked 8.6 (suggested 8.8). The most iconic inland delta in the world; at 8.4 it is below Maasai Mara & Amboseli.

name: Tierra del Fuego
why: The southern end of the Andes meeting the Beagle Channel; at 8.7 it is below Bavaria and Bend & Crater Lake.

name: Vancouver & Whistler
why: Coast Mountains rising from the sea plus Garibaldi Lake; at 9.0 it is below Denali, the Ecuadorian Andes and the Caucasus.

name: Wales
why: The whole country has Eryri, the Brecon Beacons and the Pembrokeshire cliffs; at 8.2 it is below the Lake District at 8.7 and 0.6 below the Scottish Highlands.

name: Cambodia
why: Angkor, the Tonlé Sap floodplain and the Cardamom forests; at 7.1 it is 1.6 below Myanmar and 1.2 below Laos, whose scenery is no richer.

name: Finnish Lapland
why: Fells, forests and lakes under snow; at 6.9 it is level with Churchill, Rioja and St Andrews & Fife, which have less landscape to look at.

name: Riviera Maya
why: Owner asked to lower it instead of raising the Dominican Republic (which stays at 7.6): flat jungle coast, Tulum and cenotes; 7.5 puts it level with Puerto Rico and just under the Dominican Republic.
